serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Hobo.Face.angry
Hobo: Oh! It’s you!
You: Hi…
Hobo: Can you imagine?! Some dumb fucks broke the dispenser!
You: Yeah, I saw. 
You: Wait a minute, didn’t you say that you get diarrhoea from the dispenser bread?
#Hobo.Face.normal
Hobo: Yeah, I said that.
You: So why are you so angry about it not working?
#Hobo.Face.angry
Hobo: Dude, I haven't eaten anything in a few days! All because of these riots!
Hobo: I even had to go back to drinking from puddles since someone broke faucets in my favourite mall bathroom.
You: This sucks man… Whole city is in chaos.
Hobo: Fucked up.
#Hobo.Face.smile
Hobo: A-also, my dear friend, do you have something to eat perhaps? 
#Hobo.Face.normal
You: On myself? No…
#Hobo.Face.angry
Hobo: Ahh! I think I’m going crazy from hunger!
Hobo: Y-you should run…{{wi}} You look kinda tasty right now and I wouldn’t want to attack you again…
You: O-ok, thanks for telling me.
